shared.title: How bridges stand up
shared.gist: Ada and Ben load a pine bridge until it breaks, then show why an arch carries more.
shared.lexicon:
- proof load: the most a bridge carries without bending for good
- arch
shared.sections:
1. [0:00] Loading the bridge until it fails
2. [2:40] The bridge itself

orders.heading: Loading the bridge until it fails

Paragraph 1: The first bridge failed at four tons, to the speaker's surprise.
A2 [1:02] number: The first bridge the team tried failed at four tons.
A3 [1:03] opinion, aside, high: The speaker was surprised that it failed.
